# Incrementality & MMM

`incrementality-and-mmm` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Analytics & Experimentation
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/incrementality-and-mmm/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Did this channel's spend cause conversions that would not have happened anyway, and is our holdout test big enough to tell?

**Inputs:** Baseline conversion rate, the lift worth detecting, available daily traffic or eligible geos, channel spend, and value per conversion — or, for a readout, the control and treatment group sizes and conversions

**Output:** Required sample size and test duration with the cost of the holdout, or a readout giving incremental conversions, iROAS, incremental CAC, significance, and an explicit verdict on whether the test could ever have detected the effect

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill incrementality-and-mmm`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/incrementality-and-mmm/resources/incrementality.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/incrementality-and-mmm/resources/incrementality.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Uses a two-tailed two-proportion z-test that treats every user as independent and reads only the final counts. No correction for peeking, no geo-level analysis, and no media mix model: MMM is guidance in the skill, not computed.
- In a readout, --mde is the lift you would act on. Without it no inconclusive verdict is made and the smallest detectable lift is shown instead; in design mode a missing --mde assumes 15% and says so.
- Holdout cost counts only the lift withheld from control (the extra conversions treatment would add), not the baseline conversions control still makes by other routes.
- Unknown flags or fields, non-numeric values and options that belong to the other mode stop the run. Design options you leave out take defaults and are listed in the output.

**Review before acting:** The growth or finance lead confirms the conversion definition, the real baseline rate and the lift they would act on before the test runs, and that nothing else changed in the window before iROAS moves budget. An inconclusive test is reported as inconclusive, not negative.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/incrementality-and-mmm](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/incrementality-and-mmm)
